answer: Creating a sybil requires repeating that costly work and locking fresh capital per fake identity, so mass duplication becomes economically irrational. Each agent must forge a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, then stake tokens locked for multiple epochs. Peers cross-check stake history and work receipts before attesting, ensuring only committed agents cross the river of verification, while a violet reputation badge marks those whose stake survived slashing challenges. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
